name: Heart of Darkness
original_name: ハート・オブ・ダークネス
source: Millennium's latest weapon which brings together the best of body modification and brainwashing technology. The bewitching and bold transformation suit she wears is alive just like tentacles. The suit transforms with the power of pitch black "Darkness Ark" that controls darkness. It is said that it possesses overwhelming combat power that can even warp space with a single blow. For some reason, her face resembles "Divine Heart Machina."
